small_guidance: Enable TF32 in tl.dot (allow_tf32=True) since inputs are fp32 on Ada — this roughly doubles GEMM throughput. Add larger autotune configs (BLOCK_M=256, BLOCK_N=128, BLOCK_K=64, num_warps=8, num_stages=4) and an L2-cache-friendly swizzled program-id ordering (group_m grouping) to improve weight reuse across the 8192-row activation matrix. Avoid the .t().contiguous() transpose in TritonLMHead by passing strides directly so the kernel reads wte.weight as B^T via stride args.
large_guidance: Redesign as a persistent, split-K-free GEMM with grouped program-id swizzling and TF32 mma, sharing a single autotuned kernel for both Conv1D (K=768/3072, N=2304/768/3072) and the LM head (N=50257); for the LM head, fuse the implicit transpose of wte.weight into the kernel via stride arguments rather than materializing wt=w.t().contiguous() every forward. Consider fusing the GELU and residual/bias-add epilogues into the MLP/attention projection GEMMs to eliminate separate elementwise passes, and switch storage/compute to fp16/bf16 accumulate-in-fp32 if numerics allow, since the model weights are naturally fp32 but the GEMMs are the dominant cost.
